backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only OHLCV known after the signal-date close; paper entry is the next available open with production entry slippage; exit is ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The candidate source uses only signal-date-known OHLCV, prior peer shock rows, offline industry/sector cache metadata, and SPY OHLCV. It does not ask the LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength

gate3.note: No core filter or live entry rule was added. The target source is additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: stock breakouts confirmed by both price and OBV new highs should represent cleaner accumulation than price-only or sector-breadth retreads.

2_history_check.exp-20260527-011: Down-volume absorption used prior 10-day up/down volume dominance and failed aggregate EV/PnL. This run does not retune those thresholds; it tests OBV new-high confirmation.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-018_and_022: VBB support scouts succeeded on market breadth and high close. This run is a separate stock-only source, not a VBB notional support retune.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-034_to_036: Industry/sector/breadth refinements failed; this run avoids sector/industry routing and uses ticker-level confirmation.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: Strong positive same-industry peer shocks from free OHLCV may identify liquid unshocked continuation candidates as a default-off paper candidate pool.
interpretation: The same-industry peer-shock source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry nearby OHLCV peer-shock relation/threshold variants on the same frozen windows without forward replacement rows or a stronger non-price relation source.
next_evidence_needed: A valid retry needs forward replacement-value rows or a materially stronger non-price peer relation source, such as true earnings-calendar peer events, customer/supplier links, or audited theme propagation.

source_definition: on-balance volume above prior 20-day OBV high

prediction.confidence_reason: Same-sector OHLCV peer shock was noisy. A same-industry relation is materially narrower and production-visible, but may fail from sample loss or concentration.

preflight_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: Same-industry strong positive peer shocks may create delayed continuation in liquid unshocked peers; category: candidate-pool alpha_search. It follows the playbook's preference for free, production-visible data-edge fields and stronger relation sources.

2_prior_experiments.exp-20260530-001: Read-only peer information-transfer attribution found a strong-positive sector peer shock 10d excess-return lift, but failed monotonicity and temporal-stability preregistration.
2_prior_experiments.exp-20260530-023: SEC Item 2.02 exact-industry peer transfer failed aggregate EV/PnL and concentration gates.
2_prior_experiments.exp-20260531-010: SEC Item 2.02 characteristic-similarity peer transfer was positive but failed window/sample/concentration gates.
2_prior_experiments.exp-20260531-012: Same-sector OHLCV peer-shock source improved aggregate EV only slightly, regressed late_strong, breached drawdown, and failed concentration.

preflight_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same docs/backtesting.md late_strong, mid_weak, old_thin windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL, 3/3 EV-improved windows, no PnL regression, >=20 target trades across all 3 windows, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, survival >=5%, and concentration guardrails pass.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A passing replay would still require a shared default-off paper adapter plus parity tests before production reports or any order path can use the field.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay-safe attribution remains sparse; skipped alpha_score component/threshold retunes because the latest runs failed drawdown and concentration; skipped FINRA/VBB/VCP/Companyfacts/state-surface scalar retunes because the playbook requires new forward rows or a materially different field; changed relation source rather than same-sector peer-shock thresholds.
